summary.headline: Cosmic Nativity and Rain Forecasts
summary.text: Astrological doctrine for a cosmic nativity cast from Babylon to predict wars, droughts, rains, kings, and disasters across countries, using benefics, malefics, lights, the royal lot, trigonal lords, midheaven, Jupiter, Mars, Saturn, signs, stars, and the lords of the year. It distinguishes universal and local solstices, including Ptolemy’s method, and adds a Syrian authority on forecasting heavy rain from the yearly lords, Venus, Mercury, and the Moon.
